text:
Behind almost every product made in India
is a chain of small factories.

A foundry. A machine shop.
A coating unit. An assembler.

But finding the right supplier, or the right buyer,
is still a guessing game.
Most can't afford paid directories.

So they rely on WhatsApp, phone calls,
Google and references.

And long site visits,
just to trust one new supplier.
Inside the factory, orders sit in WhatsApp.

Stock in Excel. Accounts in Tally.
Quality on paper.
The same details are typed again, and again.

Lines stop. Rejects surface late.
Good suppliers stay invisible.
Everything is scattered.
And nobody can see who actually delivers.
XELOR changes that.

The trusted network
behind what India manufactures.
Every delivery is counted at the factory gate.

So every supplier earns a real record:
on time, quality, deliveries.

Factories find, compare and choose
each other on that record.

Every request invites a new supplier.
It joins free, and brings its own buyers.
The network grows with every order.
One trusted record. Three products.

XELOR Market. Xelogram.
And an agentic AI ERP.

XELOR Market is where small manufacturers
find each other.

And see what every seller
has actually delivered.

Listing starts free,
at a fraction of a paid directory.

XELOR only connects.
It never touches the money.

A buyer's request goes to
five matched sellers at most.
Never resold. No fee per lead.

Machine down? Find help reaches the nearest
checked technicians in one tap.

Repairs, testing, compliance and finance,
all in one place.
Xelogram turns a verified delivery into a post.

The agent writes the caption, in Tamil,
Kannada, Hindi or English.
One tap to approve and share.

Buyers see real, verified work,
and ask for a quote straight from the post.
Underneath it all is an agentic AI ERP.

It links orders, suppliers, stock,
factory work and payments.

Already using Tally? It works alongside.
No need to switch.

The agent drafts the request for quotes,
chases replies and ranks the offers.
People make the decisions.
Let's follow one order, for eighty pumps.

Check the stock.
Sixty metal bodies are missing.
Send one request to three suppliers.
The supplier opens a link. No login, no app.
Adds a price and date, and sends the quote.

Compare price, delivery,
and each supplier's record.

The owner checks the amount,
and approves from the phone.

On delivery day,
scan the parts at the gate.

Check the parts.
The supplier's record updates by itself.

Send the job and its parts
to the factory team.
The team records eighty finished pumps.
Each one passes four checks.

Ship the pumps.
The bill comes from the same order.
Close the order.
And the factory's own record grows.
Every delivery builds trust.

XELOR. The trusted network
behind what India manufactures.
